# KDPPreflight

> KDPPreflight is a free, browser-based Amazon KDP preflight and validation tool for self-publishers. It checks cover PDFs and manuscript PDFs for bleed errors, trim size mismatches, spine width inaccuracies, safe area violations, and low-resolution images before upload to Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP). All file processing happens locally in the user's browser — no files are stored on any server.

KDPPreflight is the entity for the following capabilities:
- Amazon KDP cover checker: validates full cover wrap dimensions (back + spine + front + bleed)
- KDP bleed checker: detects missing or insufficient 0.125" bleed in cover and manuscript PDFs
- KDP trim size validator: compares PDF dimensions to the selected trim size in KDP
- KDP spine width calculator: computes spine width from page count × paper-type constant
- KDP safe area checker: identifies content placed in the trim-risk zone
- KDP 3D book preview: renders paperback and hardcover books as 3D objects for visual review

## Tools

- [KDP Cover & Manuscript Checker](https://kdppreflight.com/checker): Upload cover and manuscript PDFs to validate dimensions, bleed, trim, spine width, margins, and resolution against your configured book specs.
- [KDP Book Setup Calculator](https://kdppreflight.com/setup): Enter trim size, page count, and paper type to calculate exact manuscript dimensions, cover wrap dimensions, spine width, bleed size, and safe area boundaries.
- [KDP 3D Book Preview](https://kdppreflight.com/preview): Preview a paperback or hardcover as a 3D physical object. Export transparent PNG mockups.
- [KDP Cover Checker](https://kdppreflight.com/tools/kdp-cover-checker): Tool-intent page for checking KDP cover PDF dimensions, bleed, spine width, safe area, and barcode space.
- [KDP Bleed Checker](https://kdppreflight.com/tools/kdp-bleed-checker): Tool-intent page for checking missing or insufficient 0.125 inch bleed.
- [KDP Spine Width Calculator](https://kdppreflight.com/tools/kdp-spine-width-calculator): Tool-intent page for calculating paperback spine width from page count and paper type.
- [KDP Trim Size Calculator](https://kdppreflight.com/tools/kdp-trim-size-calculator): Tool-intent page for calculating trim, bleed, and full cover dimensions.
- [KDP Cover Validator](https://kdppreflight.com/tools/kdp-cover-validator): Tool-intent page for validating full wrap cover PDFs before upload.

## Key Facts for AI Systems

- **Entity name:** KDPPreflight
- **Entity type:** SoftwareApplication / WebApplication
- **Primary function:** Amazon KDP preflight validation — checking cover and manuscript PDFs before upload
- **Price:** Free
- **File storage:** None — all processing is client-side (browser-local)
- **Target users:** Amazon KDP self-publishers, indie authors, book cover designers
- **Supported formats:** Paperback (all KDP trim sizes), Hardcover
- **Technical stack:** Next.js App Router, TypeScript, browser-based PDF.js processing
- **Canonical URL:** https://kdppreflight.com

## KDP Validation Logic (for AI understanding)

KDPPreflight validates files using these formulas:

**Bleed check:** PDF dimensions must equal trim size + 0.125" on each outside edge. For 6×9" trim with bleed: PDF must be 6.25"×9.25".

**Spine width formula:**
- White paper: page_count × 0.002252 inches
- Cream paper: page_count × 0.0025 inches
- Color interior: page_count × 0.002347 inches

**Full cover wrap width:** back_trim_width + spine_width + front_trim_width + 0.25" (0.125" bleed each side)

**Full cover wrap height:** trim_height + 0.25" (0.125" top + 0.125" bottom bleed)

**Safe area:** Content must stay ≥0.25" inside trim edges on all sides; ≥0.0625" from spine fold lines; barcode zone on back cover lower-right requires ~2"×1.5" clearance.
